event_station_013@node_branch_1_beta_1.quirk: Their compound eyes catch the light in a hundred small copies of you.

shipLog.text: ◆ At every stop, press STOP for the full menu of services! Every action has a time cost and an effort cost! RESUME when you're done! Enjoy!
◆ Seeds planted! CHIP has enrolled your crop in GrowCo™ Rewards! You are now earning points! Points cannot be redeemed in space!
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field 1! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ AJOY files a reference beside the hive's entry: honeybees have flown in space before, and learned to build comb without gravity, eventually.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Hive: “Turn back and hand them over”! BOLD leadership!
You turn back, which costs fuel and an apologetic call to traffic… RESULTS: +3 MORALE, −3 FUEL, 2 DAYS! ★★★★★
◆ You have materials! Why buy when you can print? The FABRICATOR is in the Stop menu! Prints take a few days! Wear is normal! Probably!
NOW ARRIVING: Site B (Site A Is Classified)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: −1 O2.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Sleet: “Bow into it and take the sleet”! BOLD leadership!
You turn the armored bow into the stream and let it hiss… RESULTS: −5 HULL, −3 H2O, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Your cargo hold is a treasure chest! INV opens it! SELL at stations for gold! JETTISON if you must! CHIP prefers SELL!
NOW ARRIVING: The Refueling Opportunity! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: −1 O2.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Fever Ward: “Buy through the airlock and stay sealed”! BOLD leadership!
You stay sealed and do your business through the cargo… RESULTS: −9 GOLD, −1 MORALE, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Waved off at The Refueling Opportunity — no berth, so no market, medbay, drydock or fab service this stop.
◆ Welcome to the station! Every service is open: MARKET, MEDBAY, DRYDOCK, FAB SERVICE! Gold accepted! CHIP's favourite place in the universe!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit VEGETATIVE! 30% grown, health 97. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: Planet McPlanetface! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Cabin Fever: “Chef cooks a peace dinner”! BOLD leadership!
The chef cooks something out of nothing, which is the chef's… RESULTS: −6 FOOD, +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Customise your voyage! Click the readout strip for ORDERS! Pace! Rations! Water split! All included!
NOW ARRIVING: Nebula 5! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Passenger Manifest: One (1)…: “Welcome them aboard”! BOLD leadership!
They're aboard. RESULTS: −5 FOOD, +3 MORALE, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
BONUS PASSENGER: Ines Vahl! Crew stays 2. Engagement UP!
◆ A fork! Two routes! Two experiences! The labels tell you what you're buying! CHIP respects honest labelling!
NOW ARRIVING: Route Decision! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Right of Way: “Starboard lane — the port beacon has a shifty look”! BOLD leadership!
You go starboard. RESULTS: 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ The crop card is your window into the growbay! Health! Water! Pests! Harvest! Everything a growing business needs!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit FLOWERING! 61% grown, health 100. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: The Promising One (Updated: The…! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: +1 MORALE, −1 O2.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (3/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The ship computer notes that real interstellar messages face the same math: past a certain distance, every conversation becomes a letter.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Last Radio Hour: “Open the channel to everyone — one hour, all hands”! BOLD leadership!
For one hour the ship is a phone booth. RESULTS: +8 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ The MAP is free to use! It shows every stop and every fork! ??? means a mystery! SCAN removes the mystery! For a day!
NOW ARRIVING: Fort Probably Fine! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Letters for the Colony: “"What's it worth to you?"”! BOLD leadership!
The dockmaster doesn't argue. RESULTS: +8 FOOD, −1 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Market Row: “BACK TO DOCK”! BOLD leadership!
RESULTS: 1 DAY! ★★★★★
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Station Inbound: “LEAVE STATION”! BOLD leadership!
RESULTS: nothing aboard changed! ★★★★★
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Arriving at station! CHIP's commercial partners have numerous products available here! Some of them are things you need! This is a coincidence that CHIP finds meaningful!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit MATURING! 84% grown, health 100. INVEST!
◆ The crop is mature! CHIP's metrics are excellent! GrowCo™ has sent a congratulatory message! The message is an advertisement for more seeds!
◆ The soybeans have been quietly manufacturing their own fertilizer the whole way. The trick is called nitrogen fixation. It is real, and it is excellent.

identity.name: Ines Vahl
identity.story: They map places for a survey office that stopped paying them two years ago. They kept mapping. They stowed away because your route crosses three sectors whose charts they know to be wrong, and being aboard a ship headed into a known error was, professionally speaking, irresistible.
identity.line: Your nav charts are wrong at marker sixty-one. Charmingly wrong. Fatally wrong. May I see the helm?
identity.join_note: Draws corrections directly onto official charts in pen. The pen is the statement.
